cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-activity: What any connoisseur of the flesh does. I manage, I make business and I print money.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-killing-bartering: How about you pay me now?
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-killing-denouncing: She is close by, waiting right next to the building.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-killing-followup: I know exactly who is currently planing your death and where she is.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-killing-forget-it#3: I was thinking about dealing with her myself. She is an inconvenience for myself, too.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-killing/backpedalled: In that case you could just ask for my help. However, who am I to stand in your vendetta.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-killing/backpedalling: You are not going off the hook that easy after telling me something that interesting. I insist.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-killing/bartered: You drive a hard bargain. Here. Now let’s get that bloody spy.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-killing/entry: There are many that want that. That isn't exactly a surprise.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-killing/fucked-off: Now that isn’t how you talk to a Potiok. Guards, teach this ruffian a lesson.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-killing/state#3: Now that's quite welcome. Please do tell. There will even be a boon for you.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.about-self: What question is that? You walk into this building, this district, and you don’t know who owns it? Let me enlighten you, mare/stallion. I am Tout Spruiker Potiok.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.ask-about-activity: What exactly do you do here?
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.changeling-quest-attack: I am going to kill you !
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.changeling-quest-attack-with-petiole: We are going to kill you !
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.entry: Greetings, what brings you to me, the chef of this fine establishment. He’s smoking something. You are unsure what exactly.
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.entry-alt: What can I do for our potential customer?
cristal-den/brothel/pimp.talk-about-changeling-quest: Somepony is trying to kill you.
